title_en: The Book's Empty Margin: The Safe Mark

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: The clerk carried the missing names on separate slips. Some may still be caught in the binding.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: The ink joins at the corner. Cross the room, not your old trail.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: A fresh path costs less than a stubborn one.
